listing.name: agentstack
listing.tagline: Work Graph control plane: agents.work_next, one MCP
listing.description: AgentStack's control plane is the Work Graph. After the project is bound, call agents.work_next (recipe mcp_work_loop_v1) before catalog search. The same agentstack.execute tool also publishes HTML or ZIP to a live /s/ URL and stores project files. OAuth Device Code install in about 30 seconds. The Cursor Marketplace plugin is free; optional AgentStack platform account pricing is at https://agentstack.tech/pricing. Privacy and terms linked from the listing.

pricing.note: Cursor Marketplace Plugin is free (Publisher Terms §3.1). AgentStack cloud/hosting is a separate freemium product account.
